card.name: Right before a person's first name
card.fires_on: The word just before a person's first name in web text, such as a greeting (Hi), a job title (Detective, attorney, spokesperson, Professor) or a byline (by). It expects a given name to come next.

modes.label: Greeting before a name
modes.description: The word Hi at the start of a reply addressed to a named person.
modes.example: Have fun! <<Hi>> Alexander - sorry to say, but unfortunately

modes.label: Title before a name
modes.description: A job or rank word right before a named person in news or author lists.

modes.label: Byline before author
modes.description: The word by right before an author's name.
modes.example: Are two drives better than one?<<by>> Anand Lal Shimpi on July

card.writes: It promotes common first names such as Thomas, Andrew, Robert and Daniel, plus Chinese surnames.
card.plain: It fires where a person's first name is about to appear, after Hi, a title or a byline.
